mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its recent trend compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.25% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 100.5), manufacturing output expansion signals strong economic activity, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100.5, or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 20-day returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) relative to the previous quarter indicates sustained economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (quarter-over-quarter), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the core CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong housing market activity (HOUST > 550.0 thousand units), rising home construction signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 550.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
